log: THE ENGINE -- one eigendecomposition, then the 3D map and the 4D dynamics are arithmetic
Four CPUs, no GPU. So the chromosome is not integrated, it is diagonalised: a harmonic
network is a linear system, and a linear system has closed forms for both its equilibrium
contacts and its trajectory. No Hi-C is touched here -- the engine is checked against
physics whose answer was fixed before the code existed.

THE ENGINE IS PHYSICS AND IT IS CHEAP. One 0.46s decomposition of a 1,400-bead
chain gives every pair distance and every timepoint, checked against an exact identity
(5e-11), the Gaussian exponent (-1.500), the Rouse exponent (0.494) and
confinement in both space and time.
AND IT IS NOT YET A CHROMOSOME. Its P(s) is -1.500 where chr21 measures -0.964. The
bare polymer is the null model, not the answer, and the distance is now on the record.
